description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder

Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted Trigram - Mountain and Trigram - Thunder from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain

Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted Trigram - Thunder and Trigram - Mountain from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain, dealing a small amount of Electro DMG and additionally reducing the target's Vibration Strength.

Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains

Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted 2 Trigrams - Mountain from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains, healing all nearby Resonators in the team.

Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders

Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted 2 Trigrams - Thunder from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders, healing all nearby Resonators in the team once per second for 8s.

Heavy Attack - Ghost Gate Omen

When holding Normal Attack with fewer than 2 Trigrams, Buling fails the divination, becoming temporarily immobilized and losing all Trigrams and 20% of her current HP. This effect will not consume HP if Buling's current HP is below 1%.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Mid-air Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to perform Basic Attack Stage 3, dealing Electro DMG.
- After performing Dodge Counter, press Normal Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 4.

Trigram

Buling can hold up to 4 Trigrams. When Trigrams reach the max number, gaining new Trigrams moves all Trigrams 1 slot to the left, and the original leftmost Trigram will be removed.
- Trigram - Mountain is obtained when Basic Attack Stage 2 deals damage.
- Trigram - Thunder is obtained when Basic Attack Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack deals damage.
- Trigram - Thunder is obtained when casting Resonance Skill - In Shadow Thunder Stirs.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder

Tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi Trigram - Mountain dan Trigram - Thunder yang disorot dari kiri ke kanan dan melancarkan Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder, memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain

Tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi Trigram - Thunder dan Trigram - Mountain yang disorot dari kiri ke kanan dan melancarkan Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain, memberikan sedikit Electro DMG dan tambahan mengurangi Vibration Strength target.

Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains

Tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi 2 Trigram - Mountain yang disorot dari kiri ke kanan dan melancarkan Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains, memulihkan HP seluruh Resonator di tim yang berada di sekitar.

Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders

Tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi 2 Trigram - Thunder yang disorot dari kiri ke kanan dan melancarkan Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders, memulihkan HP seluruh Resonator di tim yang berada di sekitar sekali per detik selama 8 dtk.

Heavy Attack - Ghost Gate Omen

Saat menahan Normal Attack dengan Trigram kurang dari 2, Buling gagal dalam ramalan, lumpuh sementara dan kehilangan seluruh Trigram serta 20% HP saat ini. Efek ini tidak akan mengonsumsi HP jika HP Buling saat ini di bawah 1%.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-air Attack, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3, memberikan Electro DMG.
- Setelah melakukan Dodge Counter, tekan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 4.

Trigram

Buling dapat menampung hingga 4 Trigram. Saat Trigram mencapai jumlah maksimum, mendapat Trigram baru menggeser seluruh Trigram 1 slot ke kiri, dan Trigram paling kiri yang semula akan dihapus.
- Trigram - Mountain didapat saat Basic Attack Tahap 2 memberikan damage.
- Trigram - Thunder didapat saat Basic Attack Tahap 4 atau Mid-air Attack memberikan damage.
- Trigram - Thunder didapat saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - In Shadow Thunder Stirs.

description.en:
Yin-Yang Balance

When Buling obtains Minor Yin and Minor Yang, she enters the Yin-Yang Balance state, replacing her Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell with Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell: Harmony.

Flashing Thunder Spell - Harmony

Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG and generating a Five Thunders Spell Array at the target area. The array deals Electro DMG and inflicts 2 stacks of Electro Flare on all targets within it every 2s, lasting for 24s. When Five Thunders Spell Array is active, all Resonators in the team enter the Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi state.
- While in the Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi state, when any Resonator in the team casts Intro Skill, Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi becomes Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang.
- Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang grants 10% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus to all active Resonators in the team. When any Resonator in the team casts Intro Skill during this state, Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang becomes Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind.
- Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind grants 25% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus to all active Resonators in the team.

Minor Yang and Minor Yin

- Minor Yang is obtained after casting Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder or Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain.
- Minor Yin is obtained after casting Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains or Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders.
description.id:
Yin-Yang Balance

Saat Buling mendapatkan Minor Yin dan Minor Yang, ia memasuki status Yin-Yang Balance, yang mengganti Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell miliknya dengan Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell: Harmony.

Flashing Thunder Spell - Harmony

Menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG dan menciptakan Five Thunders Spell Array di area target. Array ini memberikan Electro DMG dan menimbulkan 2 stack Electro Flare pada semua target di dalamnya setiap 2 dtk, berlangsung selama 24 dtk. Saat Five Thunders Spell Array aktif, seluruh Resonator di tim memasuki status Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi.
- Dalam status Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi, saat Resonator mana pun di tim melancarkan Intro Skill, Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi berubah menjadi Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang.
- Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang memberikan 10% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus kepada semua Resonator aktif di tim. Saat Resonator mana pun di tim melancarkan Intro Skill selama status ini, Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang berubah menjadi Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind.
- Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind memberikan 25% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus kepada semua Resonator aktif di tim.

Minor Yang and Minor Yin

- Minor Yang didapat setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder atau Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain.
- Minor Yin didapat setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains atau Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders.
